record.bible_text: Then answered<WH06030><WTH8799> Bildad<WH01085> the Shuhite<WH07747>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,
How long<WH05704> <FI>will it be ere<Fi> ye make<WH07760><WTH8799> an end<WH07078> of words<WH04405>? mark<WH0995><WTH8799>, and afterwards<WH0310> we will speak<WH01696><WTH8762>.
Wherefore are we counted<WH02803><WTH8738> as beasts<WH0929>, <FI>and<Fi> reputed vile<WH02933><WTH8738> in your sight<WH05869>?

He teareth<WH02963><WTH8802> himself<WH05315> in his anger<WH0639>: shall the earth<WH0776> be forsaken<WH05800><WTH8735> for thee? and shall the rock<WH06697> be removed<WH06275><WTH8799> out of his place<WH04725>? <RF>himself: Heb. his soul<Rf><CM>
Yea, the light<WH0216> of the wicked<WH07563> shall be put out<WH01846><WTH8799>, and the spark<WH07632> of his fire<WH0784> shall not shine<WH05050><WTH8799>.
The light<WH0216> shall be dark<WH02821><WTH8804> in his tabernacle<WH0168>, and his candle<WH05216> shall be put out<WH01846><WTH8799> with him. <RF>candle: or, lamp<Rf>
The steps<WH06806> of his strength<WH0202> shall be straitened<WH03334><WTH8799>, and his own counsel<WH06098> shall cast him down<WH07993><WTH8686>.
For he is cast<WH07971><WTH8795> into a net<WH07568> by his own feet<WH07272>, and he walketh<WH01980><WTH8691> upon a snare<WH07639>.
The gin<WH06341> shall take<WH0270><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> by the heel<WH06119>, <FI>and<Fi> the robber<WH06782> shall prevail<WH02388><WTH8686> against him.
The snare<WH02256> <FI>is<Fi> laid<WH02934><WTH8803> for him in the ground<WH0776>, and a trap<WH04434> for him in the way<WH05410>. <RF>laid: Heb. hidden<Rf><CM>
Terrors<WH01091> shall make him afraid<WH01204><WTH8765> on every side<WH05439>, and shall drive<WH06327><WTH8689> him to his feet<WH07272>. <RF>drive: Heb. scatter<Rf>
His strength<WH0202> shall be hungerbitten<WH07457>, and destruction<WH0343> <FI>shall be<Fi> ready<WH03559><WTH8737> at his side<WH06763>.

It shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> the strength<WH0905> of his skin<WH05785>: <FI>even<Fi> the firstborn<WH01060> of death<WH04194> shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> his strength<WH0905>. <RF>strength: Heb. bars<Rf>
His confidence<WH04009> shall be rooted out<WH05423><WTH8735> of his tabernacle<WH0168>, and it shall bring<WH06805><WTH8686> him to the king<WH04428> of terrors<WH01091>.
It shall dwell<WH07931><WTH8799> in his tabernacle<WH0168>, because <FI>it is<Fi> none<WH01097> of his: brimstone<WH01614> shall be scattered<WH02219><WTH8792> upon his habitation<WH05116>.
His roots<WH08328> shall be dried up<WH03001><WTH8799> beneath, and above<WH04605> shall his branch<WH07105> be cut off<WH05243><WTH8799>.
His remembrance<WH02143> shall perish<WH06><WTH8804> from the earth<WH0776>, and he shall have no name<WH08034> in the street<WH06440><WH02351>.
He shall be driven<WH01920><WTH8799> from light<WH0216> into darkness<WH02822>, and chased<WH05074><WTH8686> out of the world<WH08398>. <RF>He...: Heb. They shall drive him<Rf>
He shall neither have son<WH05209> nor nephew<WH05220> among his people<WH05971>, nor any remaining<WH08300> in his dwellings<WH04033>.

They that come after<WH0314> <FI>him<Fi> shall be astonied<WH08074><WTH8738> at his day<WH03117>, as they that went before<WH06931> were affrighted<WH0270><WTH8804><WH08178>. <RF>went...: or, lived with him<Rf> <RF>were...: Heb. laid hold on horror<Rf>
Surely such <FI>are<Fi> the dwellings<WH04908> of the wicked<WH05767>, and this <FI>is<Fi> the place<WH04725> <FI>of him that<Fi> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> not God<WH0410>.<CM>
